student.lets_begin: Produce at least five accurate sentences and answer at least three questions on the topic “A memorable day in the past” using this lesson’s target structure.
student.basic_rule: Review regular and irregular simple past, and organize a short complete narrative.
student.english_comparison: English simple past is a useful rough parallel, but conjugations differ.

model_sentences.en: Then I went to the market.

multiple_choice.instruction: Choose one option for each meaning; say the chosen sentence aloud.

items.prompt: Which sentence expresses “Then I went to the market.”?
Which sentence expresses “She ate at home.”?

gap_fill.instruction: Complete the missing target form. The English meaning is provided to remove ambiguity; read each whole sentence aloud.

items.hint: Then I went to the market.

mini_reading.instruction: Read the text aloud. Then answer the questions in full sentences.
mini_reading.text: No último sábado, eu fui ao mercado. Primeiro, comprei frutas. Depois, encontrei uma amiga e conversamos. Mais tarde, fizemos o almoço em casa. Ela abriu uma bebida e eu preparei arroz. Por fim, nós descansamos no jardim.
questions: O que o narrador comprou primeiro?

review.another_way_to_understand_it: Tell what happened, in which order, and the result.
review.compare: Eu fazia (not studied) / Eu fiz: focus only on fiz in this review; don't require the imperfect.

common_mistakes.explanation: Ao is the neutral destination form.

oral_substitution_drill.instruction: Start from the base sentence. Say the new sentence in Portuguese for the English cue, without writing it first.

translate.instruction: Translate into Portuguese and say each sentence aloud.

fill_in.instruction: Fill the missing form in a two-clause context; say both sentences together. The English hint gives the meaning of the second sentence.

items.sentence: Nós fizemos o jantar. Ela ________ em casa.
Eles estudaram à noite. Nós ________ o jantar.
Por fim, eu descansei. Eles ________ à noite.
Eu trabalhei ontem. Por fim, eu ________.

listen_and_translate.instruction: Listen to three short utterances read by your teacher. Say the meaning in English, then repeat each utterance aloud.

reading_aloud_and_translation.instruction: Read the text aloud, translate it orally into English, then answer the questions.
reading_aloud_and_translation.text: Ontem Pedro teve um dia diferente. Ele foi à escola de manhã. Depois fez uma atividade de português. Ao meio-dia, comeu com os amigos. À tarde, esteve em casa. Por fim, falou com a família e dormiu cedo.
questions: Com quem Pedro comeu ao meio-dia?

speaking_practice.instruction: Answer in order: factual answers first, then personal examples and explanations. All answers are spoken in full sentences.

questions.question: Onde você foi no sábado?
questions.english: Where did you go on Saturday?

questions.question: O que você fez no primeiro dia das últimas férias?
questions.english: What did you do on the first day of your last vacation?

questions.question: Você teve algum imprevisto durante essa experiência?
questions.english: Did you have an unexpected event in that experience?

A_multiple_choice.instruction: Which sentence expresses “I worked yesterday.”? A. Eu trabalhei ontem. B. Ela comeu em casa. C. Por fim, eu descansei.
A_multiple_choice.worked_answer: A. Eu trabalhei ontem. — compare the exact meaning, then read it aloud.

B_gap_fill.worked_answer: trabalhei → Eu trabalhei ontem. — use the English hint and the rest of the sentence.

C_english_to_portuguese.worked_answer: Ela comeu em casa. — identify the subject, choose the verb form, then say it.

D_portuguese_to_english.worked_answer: I worked yesterday. — translate the meaning, not word for word.

E_reading_comprehension.instruction: O que o narrador comprou primeiro?
E_reading_comprehension.worked_answer: Ele comprou frutas. — find the sentence in the text that gives the answer, then answer in a full sentence.

F_written_production.instruction: Write one new sentence with the target form, using “Nós fizemos o jantar.” as a reference.
F_written_production.worked_answer: Model: Eles estudaram à noite. — change the information, keep the target structure correct.

G_speaking.instruction: Say one sentence with today’s structure about your own life.
G_speaking.worked_answer: Model: Por fim, eu descansei. — say it, then change one real-life detail.

your_homework.instruction: Give independent answers and speak all written sentences once.

A_multiple_choice.instruction: Choose the sentence with the given meaning.

E_reading.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions in full sentences.
E_reading.text: No mês passado, Ana viajou para visitar a irmã. Primeiro, comprou a passagem. Depois, arrumou as malas. No dia da viagem, foi ao aeroporto cedo. O voo foi tranquilo. Ela chegou à noite, abraçou a irmã e descansou.

F_written_production.instruction: Write 80–120 words on the topic “A memorable day in the past”. Use at least three different relevant examples of the target structure; add context and original details.

G_speaking.instruction: Record one uninterrupted spoken response to these three lesson prompts — Onde você foi no sábado? / O que você fez depois? / Como foi seu dia? — giving complete sentences and without reading a script.

teacher.pronunciation_focus: Work on smooth linked storytelling without dropping verb endings.

Eles estudaram à noite. Nós fizemos o jantar.
Por fim, eu descansei. Eles estudaram à noite.
Eu trabalhei ontem. Por fim, eu descansei.

reading_aloud.translation: Yesterday Pedro had an unusual day. He went to school in the morning. Then he did a Portuguese activity. At noon, he ate with friends. In the afternoon, he was at home. Finally, he spoke with his family and went to bed early.

speaking_practice.watch_for: Eu fui no mercado. → Eu fui ao mercado. (Ao is the neutral destination form.) Ela faz jantar ontem. → Ela fez o jantar ontem. (Completed past requires fez.)

speaking_practice.watch_for: Eu fui no mercado. → Eu fui ao mercado. (Ao is the neutral destination form.) Ela faz jantar ontem. → Ela fez o jantar ontem. (Completed past requires fez.)

F_written_production.model_text: No mês passado, Ana viajou para visitar a irmã. Primeiro, comprou a passagem. Depois, arrumou as malas. No dia da viagem, foi ao aeroporto cedo. O voo foi tranquilo. Ela chegou à noite, abraçou a irmã e descansou.
F_written_production.assessment: Check length, topic relevance, at least three accurate uses of the target structure, and agreement. Personal details vary.

homework.acceptable_alternatives: A different accurate subject, name, or everyday example is acceptable in open speaking/writing tasks. For closed translation tasks, accept semantically equivalent natural Brazilian Portuguese with the target structure.
